info.name: Companions
info.description: Companion stat blocks from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy): Legion demons and mounts.
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: Fel imps are mischievous demons that cackle with glee while immolating their foes in fel flames. They are the easiest demons for Warlocks to bind and control, making them common familiars for those who make pacts with the Burning Legion.
The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

sheet.description: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

description.p: The imp makes two Fel Firebolt attacks.

sheet.description: The imp makes two Fel Firebolt attacks.

description.p: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

sheet.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

description.p: Voidwalkers are creatures of the Void, hulking figures made of pure shadow. Warlocks highly prize ordinary voidwalkers as servants because of their ability to both attract and withstand enemy attacks.
The voidwalker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

sheet.description: The voidwalker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

description.p: An enemy that starts its turn within 5 feet of the voidwalker has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than a voidwalker.

sheet.description: An enemy that starts its turn within 5 feet of the voidwalker has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than a voidwalker.

description.p: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the voidwalker regains 3 Hit Points.

sheet.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the voidwalker regains 3 Hit Points.

description.p: Conscripted from the demonic mo’arg species, felguard serve as the Burning Legion’s rank-and-file soldiers. They are fearless and unwaveringly loyal to Sargeras’s godlike will.
If the felguard dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in 2d4 weeks, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

sheet.description: If the felguard dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in 2d4 weeks, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

description.p: The felguard has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

sheet.description: The felguard has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

description.p: The felguard has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the felguard’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

sheet.description: The felguard has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the felguard’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

description.p: The felguard makes two attacks, using Fel Battleaxe or Fel Javelin in any combination.

sheet.description: The felguard makes two attacks, using Fel Battleaxe or Fel Javelin in any combination.

description.p: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

sheet.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

description.p: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

sheet.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

description.p: Felhounds are demonic canines used by pit lords to sniff out sources of magic. Unlike most demons, which are born of corrupted mortals, felhounds are shaped from raw fel energy.
If the felhound dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in 2d4 weeks, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

sheet.description: If the felhound dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in 2d4 weeks, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

description.p: The felhound has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

sheet.description: The felhound has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

description.p: The felhound can sense the presence and location of magic within 120 feet of itself. It also has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have cast a spell or taken the Magic action since the end of the felhound’s last turn.

sheet.description: The felhound can sense the presence and location of magic within 120 feet of itself. It also has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have cast a spell or taken the Magic action since the end of the felhound’s last turn.

description.p: The felhound makes one Bite attack and one Grappling Tentacles attack.

description.p: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
